name: after-effects-mcp-extended
description: Extended MCP server for Adobe After Effects with unified project, media, render, and visual frame control

scripts.build: npm run build:mcp && npm run build:chat && copyfiles -u 1 "src/scripts/**/*" build
scripts.build:standalone: bun build ./src/index.ts --compile --outfile ./dist/after-effects-mcp-extended.exe && bun build ./src/chat-host.ts --compile --windows-hide-console --windows-title "After Effects Codex Chat" --windows-description "Codex chat companion for Adobe After Effects" --outfile ./dist/after-effects-codex-chat.exe && node ./scripts/set-windows-gui-subsystem.mjs ./dist/after-effects-codex-chat.exe
